title: Representable right fibrations form the universal cocartesian family
statement:
Use quasicategories, coherent functors and mapping spaces of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], cocartesian unstraightening of [lem-coef-cocartesian-straightening], and the right-fibration category $p:\operatorname{RFib}\to\operatorname{Cat}_{\mathcal U}$ of [lem-coef-day-relative-exponential-model]. Work in containing universes large enough for these categories and their unstraightenings. Let $\operatorname{RSl}$ be the replete full subcategory of $\operatorname{RFib}$ spanned by arrows equivalent over their base to $D_{/d}\to D$, for $D$ a $\mathcal U$-small infinity category and $d\in D$. Let $U\to\operatorname{Cat}_{\mathcal U}$ be the cocartesian unstraightening of the identity functor of $\operatorname{Cat}_{\mathcal U}$, performed in a larger universe. There is an equivalence $U\simeq\operatorname{RSl}$ over $\operatorname{Cat}_{\mathcal U}$, preserving cocartesian edges, whose fibre component sends $d\in D$ to $D_{/d}\to D$. Its composite with $\operatorname{RSl}\hookrightarrow\operatorname{RFib}$ has fibre component the coherent Yoneda functor $d\mapsto\operatorname{Map}_D(-,d)$, under right-fibration classification. The inclusion preserves cocartesian edges. Thus for $h:D\to E$, transport takes $D_{/d}\to D$ to $E_{/h(d)}\to E$; the edge is induced by applying $h$ to the slice arrows. More generally, the image of a morphism over $h$ with fibre component $v:h(d)\to e$ acts on slice arrows by $a:x\to d\longmapsto v\circ h(a):h(x)\to e$. These descriptions specify a coherent functor on the entire unstraightening, including arbitrary simplicial parameters, composition and identity simplices, not just its effect on objects and edges.

Finite products in $\operatorname{RSl}$ are products of arrows, and both the projection to $\operatorname{Cat}_{\mathcal U}$ and the inclusion in $\operatorname{RFib}$ preserve them. In the preceding equivalence the product comparison is the natural slice equivalence $(\prod_iD_i)_{/(d_i)}\simeq\prod_i(D_i)_{/d_i}$ over $\prod_iD_i$, with its projection cones. It is compatible with the displayed slice-action functors and all their simplicial parameters. The empty product is $*\to *$.

source.place: Chu–Haugseng, Free algebras through Day convolution, Definition 6.3, Corollaries 6.4–6.5, Remark 6.6, printed pp.13–14. Read online; archive WANTED. Explicit slice-arrow action and product-cone formulation are the agent expansion. No Stacks tag states this quasicategorical assertion.
